user.title: Add a UI-managed printer
user.description: YAML remains supported. Add each printer once, using either YAML or UI, with at most two printers total. Configuration validation does not capture images, call AI providers or send alerts.

data_description.name: A short name for the diagnostic sensor and alert title.
data_description.entity_prefix: The shared prefix of your six printer entities, for example printer_one. This printer identity cannot be changed later.
data_description.camera: An available JPEG camera showing this printer.
data_description.ai_task: Image-capable AI Task with structured data for the comparison. Its provider receives frames and telemetry and may charge.
data_description.screen_ai_task: Optional separate AI Task for the first frame. Leave empty to use the comparison task. A configured task never silently falls back.
data_description.notify_service: An existing notify action accepting title and message, for example notify.example_phone. No test alert is sent.

error.invalid_config: Enter a printable name, lowercase entity prefix, camera entity, AI Task and notify action. Check the entity domains.
error.printer_conflict: This prefix or camera is already owned by YAML or another Printer Guard entry. Remove it from that source first.
error.missing_media: Configure homeassistant.media_dirs.local as an existing, writable absolute local directory, then restart Home Assistant.
error.missing_entity: This entity does not exist. Configure the entity first or select another.
error.unavailable_entity: This entity is unavailable. Restore it or select another before saving.
error.unsupported_ai_task: Select an AI Task supporting structured data generation and image attachments.
error.missing_notify_service: This notify action is not registered. Configure it first or select another.
error.missing_printer_entities: The prefix must match existing print_status, current_stage, online, print_error, task_name and start_time entities. See the setup documentation.
error.printer_limit: Printer Guard supports at most two printers total across YAML and UI. Remove another configuration first.

init.title: Configure UI-managed printer
init.description: Edits apply by reloading this printer, canceling any in-flight assessment. The entity prefix stays fixed. These changes do not rewrite YAML.
